title: The Legendary Hero That Triples Its Weight to Fight
premise: Zacian is a Fairy-type legendary hero whose Crowned form turns absorbed metal into a Steel-type weapon.
audiencePromise: Start with the weight shock, then show how absorbing metal turns a Fairy hero into a Fairy/Steel warrior.
openLoop: How does one legendary hero more than triple its weight before a battle?
payoff: Its Crowned form adds the Steel type and takes it from 110 to 355 kilograms.
engagementQuestion: Which Zacian wins: the swift Fairy hero or the Crowned steel warrior?
voiceInstructions: Confident, heroic short-form narrator. Open with a jolt of surprise, build tension through the metal transformation, and land the Crowned form like a reveal. Crisp and natural. Never imitate a known person or character.

scenes.headline: THIS HERO TRIPLES ITS WEIGHT FOR BATTLE
scenes.narration: This legendary hero more than triples its weight.
scenes.caption: WAIT, HOW?

scenes.headline: A FAIRY-TYPE WARRIOR
scenes.narration: Zacian is the Warrior Pokémon, a legendary hero of pure Fairy type.
scenes.caption: WARRIOR • FAIRY • LEGENDARY

scenes.headline: IT TURNS METAL INTO A WEAPON
scenes.narration: It absorbs metal particles and transforms them into a weapon for battle.
scenes.caption: METAL → WEAPON

scenes.headline: THE CROWNED FORM
scenes.narration: Its Crowned form adds the Steel type, becoming Fairy and Steel at once.
scenes.caption: FAIRY + STEEL

scenes.headline: 110 KG TO 355 KG
scenes.narration: Its weight jumps from 110 to 355 kilograms in that form.
scenes.caption: MORE THAN TRIPLE

scenes.headline: SWIFT HERO OR CROWNED WARRIOR?
scenes.narration: Which Zacian is cooler: the swift Fairy hero, or the Crowned steel warrior?
scenes.caption: HERO OR CROWNED?
